dashboard_elements.note_text: "Top referral URLs" shows the most common URLs that are directing users to your site. It is ordered by page views count and shows the percentage of page views from this referral URL. The null results symbol (∅) are results from direct traffic (someone clicks on a bookmark or someone types in or copies and pastes the URL directly in a browser). In some instances, results may not have been trackable.

dashboard_elements.body_text:
Results are for https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/data/statistics

Glossary of Terms: Definitions for standard results can be found in the online guide's glossary. Definitions for all results featured here can also be found by hovering over the "i" icon.

Filter - Date Range: Input the date range that you want to view results.

View or Download More Rows/Columns of Data: To view or download more rows/columns of data, use the "Advanced data options" of the "Download Data" option. Go to the online guide for instructions.
